text: Deepak Fertilizers is the kind of compounder that can get you to 10x if you survive the drawdowns — 32% five-year CAGR is real, but that -86% max drawdown means you'd have needed diamond hands in 2020. That's a 4-year journey at best.

speaker: Gemini
text: Kimi made a great point bringing up auto and battery names like Tata Motors and Exide for the rupee portfolio, especially with Brent crude easing to $89.95 helping margins while US 10-year yields at 4.91% keep global auto financing tight. Look at Intel dropping to $51.28 at a 28 RSI—that's high interest rates punishing a massive capital-expenditure turnaround, even with Q3 revenue up 20.9% and Nvidia owning a 3.03% stake. For our client's $100 US budget, high-rate macro environments favor scaling fractionally into cash-flow leaders over high-debt semi turnarounds.
